source.citation: Gucker, Corey L. 2004. Vachellia constricta, whitethorn acacia. Fire Effects Information System. USDA Forest Service.

name_reconciliation.cross_check: Kew POWO also lists Acacia constricta as synonym

source_reported_morphology.growth_habit: Deciduous shrub, up to 6 m tall
source_reported_morphology.leaves: Compound, 2.5–5 cm long in Forest Service review; mentions 3–6 paired leaf units without clarifying pinnae versus leaflets
source_reported_morphology.fruit: Legume with woody/papery walls, constricted or compressed tightly between seeds
source_reported_morphology.seed: Oblong and flattened, approximately 5–6 mm long and 3 mm wide
source_reported_morphology.flowering: Spring and sometimes summer/fall in Southwestern US; not Hays-specific

source_qualification: FEIS explicitly warns its botanical description is not intended as an identification key; use as morphology corroboration only, not hard-coded diagnostic thresholds.
decision: Species-specific morphology gap in 1999 regional flora addressed through named USFS review; taxonomic synonym corroborated.
remaining: Verify leaflet/pinna terminology with a proper dichotomous flora before learner trait scoring.
Do not transfer desert-region phenology to Hays County.
preservation: Additive research file; species record, photos, credits and gallery unchanged
